name: REGENT SQUARE
confidence: high for the notes; check the barring
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Psalms and Hymns for Divine Worship, 1867, where the tune first appeared); the opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit.
reviewNotes: Notes and rhythm high. The barring follows the 1867 source: each line starts with two crotchets before the bar line ('An-gels | from the realms of | glo-ry'). Some books bar it from the first note instead; the solfa and the rhythm are the same either way.
